card.name: Linking words after not/avoid verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, from, the, or) right after a negated or avoidance phrase such as "not removed", "avoid use on", "will not get rid", where a body part, site or thing to be kept away is about to be named.

modes.label: Removal wording
modes.description: "of" or "from" after get rid, removed, or not removed, before the thing being cleared away.
modes.example: Valsartan s not removed<< from>> the plasma by hemodialysis.

modes.label: Avoid-use sites
modes.description: "the" or "or" after avoid use on or avoid contact with, before body sites to avoid.
modes.example: Avoid use on<< the>> face, groin, or axillae

card.writes: It seems to favor words that continue a restriction or a clean/unaltered state and to lower words like harmful or excessive.
card.plain: It marks the small word after phrases like "not removed from" or "avoid use on", just before the place or thing is named.
